# OpenMoji (black line variant)

All emojis designed by **OpenMoji** – the open-source emoji and icon project. https://openmoji.org
License: CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Files here are the `black/svg/<code>.svg` line versions from npm package `openmoji@17.0.0`, renamed by `names.json`.
Colors are remapped at runtime (stroke color / width); those derivatives are shared under the same license.
